title: POLAND FACES RUSSIAN HYBRID ONSLAUGHT AMID BALTIC DEFENSE SURGE
excerpt: Poland battles Russian hybrid warfare including sabotage and cyberattacks while Baltic states dramatically increase defense spending. Lithuania approves record 5.38% GDP defense budget.
body: Poland faces escalating Russian hybrid warfare including railway sabotage, cyberattacks (2,000-4,000 daily), and disinformation campaigns. The Tusk government frames these threats as tied to Poland's pro-NATO stance. Meanwhile, the Baltic states are dramatically increasing defense spending. Lithuania's Seimas approved a record â¬4.8 billion defense budget at 5.38% of GDP, more than double the NATO 2% target. Latvia braces for Russian-Belarusian hybrid assault on its 2026 elections using AI deepfakes and disinformation. Estonia maintains its commitment to collective defense amid regional tensions.
keywords: Poland hybrid warfare, Lithuania defense budget, Latvia elections, Estonia security, Baltic NATO
sources: Poland Ministry of Digital Affairs; Lithuanian Seimas; Latvia Constitution Protection Bureau
